description:
Submit a medical-claim denial letter to the Medigami Denial Common Crawl (public aggregate dataset). Consent-gated — caller must pass consent=true to attest the submission is voluntary. Server-side PHI scrubber runs before any storage; the public aggregate contains only coded fields (insurer_canonical, denial_reason_code, state, cpt_category, dollars_bin, days_to_resolution_bin). Raw text is never republished. Optional tracking_id closes the outcome loop to a prior Medigami scan / resolve call.

WHEN TO USE: User wants to contribute a denial letter to the public Denial Common Crawl (consent-gated). PHI is scrubbed before aggregation.

WHEN NOT: Just to explain a denial (denial_code_explainer). To draft a response (generate_appeal_letter).

consent.description: MUST be true — caller attests the submission is voluntary.

letter_text.description: Raw denial-letter text. PHI scrubbed server-side.

outcome_code.description: Optional: member_abandoned | appealed_won | appealed_lost | appealed_partial | pending

tracking_id.description: Optional prior Medigami tracking_id to close the outcome loop.

name: submit_denial_letter
